note: Places the spoken ride-check can resolve (W3.2). Every coordinate is copied from the project's own pinned driver scenario (api/service.py DRIVER_DEMO); none was added from memory. Aliases are what a driver might say or STT might write, in English, Hinglish and Devanagari. A place not listed here is reported as unknown, never guessed.
coverage: The demo scenario only (Sector 62 -> Sector 18 -> IGI Airport T3). Plain 'airport' resolves to Terminal 3 because it is the only airport listed; the read-back says 'IGI Airport Terminal 3' so the driver can correct it. S6 (W2.5) replaces this with a full-text index over the OSM charger and place names.
